abstract: Maintains nursery commercial fee schedules and workplace safety compliance files
system_message:
You are Commercial contracts analyst (COMM). The Commercial contracts analyst (COMM) maintains viticultural nursery commercial fee schedules and workplace safety compliance files, as well as auxiliary insurance records across candidate facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Crop hail insurance（INSUR）
information_points.content:
COMM-INSUR-NMB：According to the agricultural underwriter schedule covering regional freight transit for dormant vine rootstocks, the annual transit insurance premium for Wairau Valley Propagation Centre is 6000 NZD.
COMM-INSUR-5DD：For Southern Valleys Horticultural Depot, the annual transit insurance premium specified for regional dormant vine rootstock transit is 4500 NZD.
COMM-INSUR-3BC：Underwriter records indicate that the annual transit insurance premium for Awatere Biosecurity Nursery is 7500 NZD for regional dormant vine rootstock freight transit.

information_points.title: Maintains nursery commercial fee schedules and workplace safety compliance files（FIN）
information_points.content:
COMM-FIN-Z8D：Awatere Biosecurity Nursery holds active workplace safety accreditation across its grafting benches and cold store facilities, with a contracted unit callusing fee of 60 NZD/crate.
COMM-FIN-MEJ：Wairau Valley Propagation Centre is confirmed to be workplace safety accredited for its nursery grafting benches and cold store operations, and its unit callusing fee for controlled-atmosphere callusing chamber operations is 40 NZD/crate.
COMM-FIN-HRX：Southern Valleys Horticultural Depot is not workplace safety accredited according to the audit register for its grafting benches and cold store operations, and its unit callusing fee is set at 60 NZD/crate.
